answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 11286 Country: AU Title: does wearing pant below ankle is a sign of proudness? if not,is it permitted to wear dress below ankle? Question: does wearing pant below ankle is a sign of proudness? if not,is it permitted to wear dress below ankle? Answer ID: 11286 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 305/278=B/1430) Yes, it is sign of arrogance to wear pyjama, lungi or pant below ankles, this is the way of the arrogant; it is not allowed to wear dress below ankles. Allah will not have a look of mercy upon such person. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
